description: This file defines the `Worksheet` class within the PhpSpreadsheet library's Xls writer module. It handles exporting worksheet data to the BIFF8 format used by Excel in XLS files. The class includes methods for writing various Excel BIFF records such as sheet dimensions, cell data, styles, protection, layout, headers, footers, and hyperlinks, among others. It manages the internal state necessary to generate a correct XLS worksheet, including column info, merged cells, margins, protection settings, and more.

classes.name: Worksheet
classes.description: Defines an Excel worksheet object for writing XLS files in BIFF8 format, including methods for exporting cell data, styles, layout, and protection information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Worksheet object with references to string tables, parser, style info, worksheet data, and configuration parameters. Sets up initial state including the bounds of used rows and columns.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Performs finalization of the worksheet, writing all necessary BIFF records such as cells, layout, formatting, protections, and hyperlinks to the internal buffer.

methods.name: writeConditionalFormatting
methods.description: Processes conditional formatting rules and writes corresponding BIFF records.

methods.name: writeBIFF8CellRangeAddressFixed
methods.description: Creates a BIFF binary representation for a fixed cell range address, e.g., 'A1:B2'.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current internal buffer data as a string, representing the worksheet's BIFF data.

methods.name: printRowColHeaders
methods.description: Sets whether to print row and column headers on printout.

methods.name: setOutline
methods.description: Configures sheet outline and groupings settings such as visibility of outline symbols and styles.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Writes a numeric cell value at a specified row and column.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string cell as SST or label record.

methods.name: writeRichTextString
methods.description: Writes a rich text string cell with detailed styling and font info.

methods.name: writeLabelSst
methods.description: Writes a label cell with string sharing through SST.

methods.name: writeBlank
methods.description: Writes a blank cell with optional formatting.

methods.name: writeBoolErr
methods.description: Writes a boolean or error cell.

methods.name: writeFormula
methods.description: Writes a formula cell, parsing the formula and storing its binary representation, optionally including calculated value.

methods.name: writeStringRecord
methods.description: Writes a string record for formulas that return strings.

methods.name: writeUrl
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to a cell.

methods.name: writeUrlRange
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to a range of cells, for internal, external, or web URLs.

methods.name: writeUrlWeb
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink of web type (http, https, ftp, mailto).

methods.name: writeUrlInternal
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to an internal worksheet cell range.

methods.name: writeUrlExternal
methods.description: Writes a hyperlink to an external file or URL.

methods.name: writeRow
methods.description: Defines height and formatting for a specific row.

methods.name: writeDimensions
methods.description: Writes the dimensions (area) of used sheet cells.

methods.name: writeWindow2
methods.description: Writes the Windows options for the worksheet view.

methods.name: writeDefaultRowHeight
methods.description: Writes default row height BIFF record.

methods.name: writeDefcol
methods.description: Writes default column width.

methods.name: writeColinfo
methods.description: Writes column width and style info for a range of columns.

methods.name: writeSelection
methods.description: Writes the current selection/boundary info.

methods.name: writeMergedCells
methods.description: Writes merged cell ranges.

methods.name: writeSheetLayout
methods.description: Writes sheet tab color if set.

methods.name: protectionBitsDefaultFalse
methods.description: Helper for protection bits, returns bitmask when protection feature is false.

methods.name: protectionBitsDefaultTrue
methods.description: Helper for protection bits, returns bitmask when protection feature is true.

methods.name: writeSheetProtection
methods.description: Writes sheet protection record based on protection settings.

methods.name: writeRangeProtection
methods.description: Writes protected cell ranges with optional passwords.

methods.name: writePanes
methods.description: Writes pane (freeze/unfreeze) settings.

methods.name: writeSetup
methods.description: Writes page setup parameters like paper size, orientation, scales, margins.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Writes page header.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Writes page footer.

methods.name: writeHcenter
methods.description: Writes horizontal centering setting.

methods.name: writeVcenter
methods.description: Writes vertical centering setting.

methods.name: writeMarginLeft
methods.description: Writes left page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginRight
methods.description: Writes right page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginTop
methods.description: Writes top page margin.

methods.name: writeMarginBottom
methods.description: Writes bottom page margin.

methods.name: writePrintHeaders
methods.description: Writes headers print setting.

methods.name: writePrintGridlines
methods.description: Writes gridlines print setting.

methods.name: writeGridset
methods.description: Writes gridline visibility setting.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterInfo
methods.description: Writes auto filter info record.

methods.name: writeGridset
methods.description: Writes the GRIDSET BIFF record indicating whether the gridlines are shown or hidden, based on print gridline settings.

methods.name: writeAutoFilterInfo
methods.description: Writes the AUTOFILTERINFO BIFF record, configuring the number of autofilter dropdowns in the sheet.

methods.name: writeGuts
methods.description: Writes the GUTS BIFF record, setting outline margin sizes and maximum outline levels based on row and column outline levels.

methods.name: writeWsbool
methods.description: Writes the WSBOOL BIFF record, mainly for print fit-to-page settings and outline symbol display.

methods.name: writeBreaks
methods.description: Writes horizontal and vertical page break BIFF records based on the sheet's row and column breaks.

methods.name: writeProtect
methods.description: Sets the worksheet protection flag in the BIFF record if sheet protection is enabled.

methods.name: writeScenProtect
methods.description: Writes the SCENPROTECT BIFF record if scenarios are protected and sheet protection is active.

methods.name: writeObjectProtect
methods.description: Writes the OBJECTPROTECT BIFF record if object protection is enabled.

methods.name: writePassword
methods.description: Writes the worksheet password record if a password has been set for sheet protection.

methods.name: insertBitmap
methods.description: Inserts a bitmap image into the worksheet at a specified cell coordinate, scaling and positioning it.

methods.name: positionImage
methods.description: Calculates the vertices and position of an image in the worksheet coordinate space based on cell size and offsets.

methods.name: writeObjPicture
methods.description: Creates the OBJ record for a picture object with specified positioning parameters.

methods.name: processBitmapGd
methods.description: Converts a GD image resource into the internal BIFF format for embedding in Excel.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Processes a bitmap file (e.g., BMP) to extract size and pixel data for embedding.

methods.name: writeZoom
methods.description: Stores the sheet's zoom scale in the BIFF record unless it defaults to 100%.

methods.name: getEscher
methods.description: Accessor for the Escher object managing drawings and images.

methods.name: setEscher
methods.description: Setter for the Escher object used for drawing objects.

methods.name: writeMsoDrawing
methods.description: Writes MSO (Microsoft Office drawing) records, including embedded Escher data and related OBJ records.

methods.name: writeDataValidity
methods.description: Writes data validation collection records such as DATAVALIDATIONS and individual DATAVALIDATION entries, including formulas and cell ranges.

methods.name: writePageLayoutView
methods.description: Writes the Page Layout View BIFF record, including zoom level, view flags, and other display options.

methods.name: writeCFRule
methods.description: Writes a Conditional Formatting rule, encoding condition type, operators, styles, fonts, borders, fills, and formulas.

methods.name: writeCFHeader
methods.description: Writes the CFHEADER BIFF record, defining the scope of conditional formatting for a cell range.

methods.name: getDataBlockProtection
methods.description: Generates protection bits for conditional formatting based on cell protection styles.
